faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers regarding the procedures, legality, and requirements of Lumintu Global's overseas placement programs.

items.q: Is this program official and legally safe?
items.a: Yes, 100% official. PT Limpah Luhur Lumintu (Lumintu Global) operates as an official partner of Kadin Sukabumi, and all placements are registered and supervised by BP2MI and the Indonesian Ministry of Manpower.

items.q: Are there upfront registration fees or broker charges?
items.a: We enforce strict transparency. There are zero 'broker fees'. Some programs, like the General Worker track to Malaysia, are Zero Cost (no placement fees). For other tracks, official costs are fully detailed before you sign any contract.

items.q: Is a foreign language certificate required before applying?
items.a: It depends on the track. The General Worker track (e.g., Malaysia/Middle East) usually does not require language certification. For the Formal/Skilled track (Japan/Germany), we provide integrated language training if you don't already have a certificate.

items.q: Can I apply if my highest education is only Junior or Senior High School?
items.a: Absolutely. We have a Vocational Track (General Worker) specifically designed for Junior/Senior High School (SMP/SMA/SMK) graduates. You will receive basic skills training prior to departure.

items.q: How long does the process take from application to departure?
items.a: The timeline varies by destination and document readiness. The General Worker track (e.g., Malaysia) takes an estimated 2-3 months. The Skilled Worker track (e.g., Japan/Germany) may take 4-8 months due to mandatory language and competency certification training.

about.title: Building Global Careers, Securing Futures
about.subtitle: PT Limpah Luhur Lumintu (Lumintu Global) is dedicated to opening access for Indonesian professional and vocational workforce to international markets legally, safely, and with dignity.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To become the leading and most trusted overseas employment placement agency (P3MI) in Indonesia, prioritizing the protection, welfare, and competency development of Indonesian Migrant Workers.

mission.title: Our Mission
items: Provide 100% official and verified overseas job opportunities.
Offer comprehensive dormitory facilities, technical training, and language certification.
Ensure a transparent placement process and eradicate illegal brokerage (No Hidden Fees).
Collaborate closely with government agencies, BP2MI, and regional strategic partners.

legality.title: Legality & Compliance
legality.desc: We fully comply with the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Our entire placement process is directly supervised by the government to ensure your rights and safety are guaranteed from departure until you return home.

partnership.title: Kadin Sukabumi City
partnership.desc: Lumintu Global is proud to be the official partner of the Indonesian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin) for the Sukabumi City. This synergy is specifically designed to advance the regional economy and elevate the global competitiveness of Sukabumi's human resources.

contact.title: Start Your Global Career Journey
contact.subtitle: The Lumintu Global team is ready to assist you. Visit our office in Sukabumi or contact our customer service for official placement consultation.
contact.cta: Need quick help? Our support team is active during working hours (08:00 - 17:00 WIB).

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using the Lumintu Global website, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

sections.title: 2. Our Services
sections.content: Lumintu Global (PT Limpah Luhur Lumintu) is an official Indonesian Migrant Worker Placement Company (P3MI). We facilitate job vacancy information, registration, and overseas employment placement processes legally.

sections.title: 3. Data Validity
sections.content: You guarantee that all personal information and documents submitted through the registration form are true, accurate, and legally yours. Falsification of documents may result in the cancellation of the placement process.

sections.title: 4. Fee Policy (No Hidden Fees)
sections.content: We uphold full transparency. Information regarding placement fees (including Zero Cost programs) will be explained in writing and officially before you sign any employment contract.

sections.title: 5. Changes to Terms
sections.content: Lumintu Global reserves the right to change these Terms and Conditions at any time for compliance with new BP2MI/Ministry of Manpower regulations. Changes take effect immediately upon posting.

sections.title: 1. Data Collection
sections.content: We collect personal information voluntarily provided by you through the registration form, including but not limited to full name, WhatsApp number, age, education history, and domicile.

sections.title: 2. Data Usage
sections.content: The collected data is used strictly for recruitment purposes: matching you with suitable job vacancies, contacting you for interviews, and processing departure documents.

sections.title: 3. Data Sharing and Security
sections.content: We fiercely protect your privacy. Data will not be sold to third parties. It is only shared with prospective overseas employers and government agencies (BP2MI/Ministry of Manpower/Immigration) for legal processing.

sections.title: 4. User Rights
sections.content: You have the right to request a review, update, or deletion of your personal data from our database at any time by contacting official Lumintu Global customer service.
